answer: A practical defence is Approved physiotherapist registration with health professions attestation. It rests on a registration the council renews after CPD, which gives every honest agent a knoll that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a registration the council renews after CPD stays private; the timber is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the pearl cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
